safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the 3–4 month duration and “sore” quality reduces the clinical picture of chronicity and symptom burden, which can affect assessment of severity, trigger correlation, and follow-up planning. This is unlikely to cause direct injury but can reduce documentation quality and continuity of care.
